title: Hide autohiding panel on mouseover after a task demands attention
line: An auto-hide panel that popped up because a window wants attention now hides again once you move the pointer away from it.
explanation: PanelView::restoreAutoHide() keeps an auto-hide panel shown for as long as its containment is in NeedsAttentionStatus, which the task manager sets while any window demands attention. So the panel only hid again after the user switched to that window, even if they had already looked at the panel and moved on. The panel now remembers that the pointer left it while the attention was pending and lets itself hide; the flag is cleared on every containment status change, so a new attention request reveals the panel again.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: hide auto-hide panel again after the user looked at it

An auto-hide panel shown because a task demands attention stayed visible
until the attention was cleared. Now it hides once the pointer leaves
it, and only shows again when a new attention request arrives.

BUG: 435095

media.caption: Master: an xterm demands attention, the panel shows; hovering the panel and moving away leaves it shown
Fixed: same steps, the panel hides as soon as the pointer leaves it
Master, frames at 3 s (attention), 6.5 s (hovered), 8 s and 13 s (pointer away): panel stays
Fixed, same frames: the panel is gone after the pointer leaves

reviews.text: Tracking pointer dismissal on QEvent::Leave is the right approach and matches the requested KDE 4 behavior without adding settings or timers. However, refreshStatus() unconditionally clears m_attentionDismissed on every containment status transition: if the user dismisses the panel while a task still demands attention and then opens and closes any panel popup or keyboard focus (e.g. Kickoff or System Tray, which temporarily raises status to RequiresAttentionStatus/AcceptingInputStatus and returns to NeedsAttentionStatus), m_attentionDismissed is wiped and showTemporarily() leaves the panel stuck visible again.
changes: In PanelView::refreshStatus(), only clear m_attentionDismissed when attention is actually cleared (status < Plasma::Types::NeedsAttentionStatus || status == Plasma::Types::HiddenStatus), and in the NeedsAttentionStatus branch only call showTemporarily() when !m_attentionDismissed (otherwise call restoreAutoHide()).
In PanelView::event() under QEvent::Leave, guard setting m_attentionDismissed = true with edgeActivated() so non-autohide panels do not prematurely latch dismissal before switching visibility mode.
Re-verify opening and closing a panel popup (such as Kickoff) after dismissing an attention-demanding panel to ensure the panel hides again immediately.
